description: Summary figure: GH25 catalytic residue status of LYS-1 across C. elegans paralogs, AlphaFold catalytic-pair geometry, and a 300-protein nematode-wide clade scan
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests, os
plt.rcParams.update({"font.size":9,"axes.titlesize":10})

dfn=pd.read_csv("nematode_PF31264_catalytic_scan.csv")
dfm=pd.read_csv("catalytic_site_mapping.csv")

def parse(p):
    at=[]
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith("ATOM"):
            at.append((l[12:16].strip(), l[17:20].strip(), int(l[22:26]), float(l[30:38]), float(l[38:46]), float(l[46:54]), float(l[60:66])))
    return pd.DataFrame(at,columns=["name","res","resi","x","y","z","b"])
AT={a:parse(f"AF-{a}.pdb") for a in ["O62415","Q20968","Q20967","Q27650"]}
def tip(a,i):
    s=AT[a][AT[a].resi==i]; ca=s[s.name=="CA"][["x","y","z"]].values[0]
    sc=s[~s.name.isin(["N","CA","C","O"])]
    if len(sc)==0: return ca
    v=sc[["x","y","z"]].values; return v[np.argmax(np.linalg.norm(v-ca,axis=1))]
pairs=[("LYS-6 (active)\nD112~E114","Q20968",112,114),("LYS-5 (active)\nD113~E115","Q20967",113,115),
       ("Eh LYS1 (active)\nD109~E111","Q27650",109,111),("LYS-1\nQ154~S157","O62415",154,157)]
dists=[float(np.linalg.norm(tip(a,i)-tip(a,j))) for _,a,i,j in pairs]

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,8.6))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,height_ratios=[1.05,1],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.32)

# Panel A: C. elegans paralog table
axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:2]); axA.axis("off")
sub=dfm[dfm.ref=="EhLYS1"].pivot_table(index="query",columns="slot",values="q_aa",aggfunc="first")
pos=dfm[dfm.ref=="EhLYS1"].pivot_table(index="query",columns="slot",values="q_pos",aggfunc="first")
order=["lys-1","lys-2","lys-3","lys-7","lys-8","lys-4","lys-5","lys-6","lys-10"]
cols=["D1","D2","E"]
axA.set_title("A  Residue in each C. elegans LYS paralog at the three GH25 catalytic positions\n(mapped by global alignment to Entamoeba histolytica LYS1 D18/D109/E111)",loc="left")
for ci,c in enumerate(cols):
    axA.text(0.33+ci*0.17,0.93,{"D1":"Asp1 (D18)","D2":"Asp2 (D109)","E":"Glu (E111)"}[c],ha="center",fontweight="bold")
for ri,g in enumerate(order):
    y=0.84-ri*0.093
    axA.text(0.02,y,g,fontweight="bold")
    axA.text(0.14,y,"long / LYS-1 clade" if g in ["lys-1","lys-2","lys-3","lys-7","lys-8"] else "short / LYS-6 clade",
             color="#8a6d3b" if g in ["lys-1","lys-2","lys-3","lys-7","lys-8"] else "#2a6f4e",fontsize=8)
    for ci,c in enumerate(cols):
        aa=sub.loc[g,c] if g in sub.index else "-"
        p=pos.loc[g,c] if g in pos.index else np.nan
        ok = aa==("D" if c!="E" else "E")
        axA.text(0.33+ci*0.17,y,f"{aa}{'' if pd.isna(p) else int(p)}",ha="center",
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.28",fc="#cfe8d8" if ok else "#f4cccc",ec="none"))
axA.text(0.02,0.02,"green = catalytic residue retained, red = substituted",fontsize=8,style="italic")

# Panel B: geometry
axB=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
cols_b=["#2a6f4e","#2a6f4e","#2a6f4e","#c0392b"]
axB.bar(range(4),dists,color=cols_b)
for i,d in enumerate(dists): axB.text(i,d+0.12,f"{d:.1f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
axB.set_xticks(range(4)); axB.set_xticklabels([p[0] for p in pairs],fontsize=7.5)
axB.set_ylabel("side-chain tip distance (A)")
axB.set_title("B  Catalytic acid/base pair geometry\nin AlphaFold models",loc="left")
axB.axhspan(3.0,4.2,color="#2a6f4e",alpha=0.12)
axB.text(0.05,4.3,"H-bonded Asp-Glu pair range",fontsize=7.5,color="#2a6f4e")
axB.set_ylim(0,6.6)

# Panel C: nematode-wide scan
axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
ct=pd.crosstab(dfn.closer_to,dfn.intact_DDE)
ct=ct.reindex(index=["lys-6-like","lys-1-like"])
b1=axC.barh(range(2),ct[True].values,color="#2a6f4e",label="intact Asp-Asp-Glu")
b2=axC.barh(range(2),ct[False].values,left=ct[True].values,color="#c0392b",label="triad disrupted")
axC.set_yticks(range(2)); axC.set_yticklabels([f"LYS-6-like clade\n(n={ct.loc['lys-6-like'].sum()})",f"LYS-1-like clade\n(n={ct.loc['lys-1-like'].sum()})"])
for i,r in enumerate(ct.index):
    axC.text(ct.loc[r,True]/2 if ct.loc[r,True]>8 else ct.loc[r,True]+3, i, str(ct.loc[r,True]), va="center",ha="center",color="white" if ct.loc[r,True]>8 else "black",fontsize=8)
    axC.text(ct.loc[r,True]+ct.loc[r,False]/2, i, str(ct.loc[r,False]), va="center",ha="center",color="white",fontsize=8)
axC.set_xlabel("number of nematode proteins"); axC.legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="lower right")
axC.set_title("C  300 nematode Pfam PF31264 proteins\nFisher OR = 950, p = 6.5e-61",loc="left")

# Panel D: triad string frequencies in the LYS-1 clade
axD=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
vc=dfn[dfn.closer_to=="lys-1-like"].triad.value_counts().head(7)[::-1]
axD.barh(range(len(vc)),vc.values,color=["#c0392b" if t!="DDE" else "#2a6f4e" for t in vc.index])
axD.set_yticks(range(len(vc))); axD.set_yticklabels(vc.index,family="monospace")
axD.set_xlabel("count"); axD.set_title("D  Triad composition, LYS-1-like clade\n(C. elegans LYS-1 = D-Q-S)",loc="left")

# Panel E: per-residue pLDDT around the catalytic positions in LYS-1
axE=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,2])
pl=AT["O62415"].groupby("resi").b.first()
axE.plot(pl.index,pl.values,color="#555",lw=0.9)
for p,lab,c in [(64,"D64",'#2a6f4e'),(154,"Q154",'#c0392b'),(157,"S157",'#c0392b'),(260,"D260",'#2a6f4e')]:
    axE.scatter([p],[pl.loc[p]],color=c,zorder=5,s=28)
    axE.annotate(lab,(p,pl.loc[p]),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(0,-14),ha="center",fontsize=8,color=c)
axE.set_xlabel("LYS-1 residue"); axE.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); axE.set_ylim(30,105)
axE.set_title("E  AlphaFold confidence at the mapped\ncatalytic positions (all > 94)",loc="left")
fig.suptitle("C. elegans LYS-1 (O62415) is a GH25 fold protein that has lost the catalytic Asp-x-Glu pair",y=0.985,fontsize=12.5)
plt.show()
print({p[0].replace(chr(10),' '):round(d,2) for p,d in zip(pairs,dists)})
